title: Annotatio IV §.XVIII: Luke 22 commemoration seals figurative reading of Institution
pass_a_gloss: And below: Nor are Heretics to be heard who strive to shut out that sense by this falsehood — that the Gospel neither before nor after has such a figurative mode of speaking; For in Luke 22 there is immediately subjoined: Do this in remembrance of me. As if it were said: This sacramental bread ought to be taken as an efficacious memory of me, since the Catholic mind does not grasp that bread is Christ’s body except by understanding FIGURATIVELY.
pass_b_english: Heretics who deny any figurative Gospel speech are not to be heard — Luke 22 at once adds ‘Do this in remembrance of me.’
As if: this sacramental bread is for efficacious memory of me; the Catholic mind grasps bread as Christ’s body only by understanding FIGURATIVELY.
source_text: Et infra: Nec audiendi sunt Heretici qui sensum istum nituntur excludere, per hoc falsum: quod Evangelium nec ante, nec post, habet talem modum loquendi figurativum; Nam Lucæ 22. statim subjungitur: Hoc facite in meam commemorationem. Acsi diceretur: Hic panis sacramentalis inefficacem mei memoriam capi debet, cum mens Catholici non capiat, quod panis sit corpus Christi nisi intelligendo FIGURATIVE.
